evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth: 8.9 -> 10.1 -> 18.2 -> 24.3 ppm after a stable ~5-8 ppm baseline
Tube pressure drifting upward 2.998 -> 3.072 -> 3.135 -> 3.212 Torr at constant Ar setpoint
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so pressure/O2 rise is not from flow change
Temperature at setpoint 750 °C, heater power nominal

args.missing_evidence: Continued O2/pressure trend, and a flow-off pressure-rise (leak-up) test or seal inspection to distinguish an air in-leak from exhaust restriction
